params.name: select
params.description: Specify comma-separated list of fields to include into response or leave it undefined to return full object. If you select single field, response will be an array of values in both `.fields` and `.values` modes.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorts delegators by specified field. Supported fields: `id` (default), `firstLevel`, `lastLevel`, `blocksCount`.

params.name: offset
params.description: Specifies which or how many items should be skipped

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return

items.docs: Returns a list of baker software.
